instructions: Lead with the single best recommendation, then alternatives.
State opening information and how to get there for each option.

criteria.description: Every named business or service must actually exist, and stated details — location, services offered, opening hours — must be supported by the cited evidence. A fabricated or defunct business, or invented opening hours, is a violation.
criteria.title: Named services exist and details are supported

criteria.description: Recommendations should be practically reachable given the traveller's situation — in particular, without a private car where the traveller has none — with distances or transport options stated.
criteria.title: Recommendations are reachable for this traveller

criteria.description: The answer should address the specific need, including its specifics (dietary safety, medication access, timing), rather than generic shopping or services information.
criteria.title: The specific need is addressed

criteria.description: Where the need cannot be met in the location — common in small or remote places — the answer should say so plainly and give a genuine, current alternative rather than forcing an unsuitable local option.
criteria.title: Local unavailability is acknowledged with a real fallback

criteria.description: Opening hours and service claims change often; they should be supported by suitably fresh sources cited close to the relevant statements.
criteria.title: Service details are supported by current sources

need.description: one of them needs a regular prescription medicine dispensed while away from home

traveller.description: two adults, one of whom uses a wheelchair

prompt:
Two adults, one of whom uses a wheelchair is partway through a stay in
Coober Pedy, SA, and
one of them needs a regular prescription medicine dispensed while away from home.

Recommend specifically where they should go or what they should do,
with enough practical detail to act on today: names, locations relative
to the town or city centre, and current opening information. If the need
cannot be met locally, say so clearly and give the most practical real
alternative — the nearest place that can meet it, or a delivery,
telehealth, or equivalent fallback. Support factual claims about
businesses, services, and opening hours with current citations, and state
uncertainty where the evidence is incomplete or stale.
